name: search_notebook
description: Full-text search over every page and block. Returns matching blocks with page title, path, block id and a snippet. Use it to find pages or blocks by words they contain; use tasks, tagged_blocks or mentions for structured questions.

limit.description: Most items to return. Default 50, at most 200.

name: list_pages
description: Lists pages with title, path, daily date (for daily pages), last change time, task count and incoming reference count. Filter by namespace (the part of a title before the last /, or the page's folder such as People), title prefix, words anywhere in the title (contains), daily date range or change date. Sort by title, date (daily date, newest first) or modified (newest first).

daily_from.description: Earliest daily date. As YYYY-MM-DD or "today".

daily_to.description: Latest daily date. As YYYY-MM-DD or "today".

modified_after.description: Only pages changed on or after this date. As YYYY-MM-DD or "today".

limit.description: Most items to return. Default 50, at most 200.

name: read_page
description: Reads one page as Markdown with its block ids (^id at the end of a line) and a key for every block (by line), plus its tags, task count, incoming reference count and daily date. Long pages are cut at 60,000 characters; pass from_line and to_line to read the rest.

page.description: Page title, notebook-relative path such as "Projects/Plan.md", or "today" for today's daily page.

name: read_block
description: Reads one block by its id with its child blocks, the page it is on and the text of its parent blocks.

name: linked_references
description: Lists the blocks on other pages that link to a page or to one of its blocks, newest daily page first, with each block's text.

page.description: Page title, notebook-relative path such as "Projects/Plan.md", or "today" for today's daily page.

limit.description: Most items to return. Default 50, at most 200.

name: tagged_blocks
description: Lists blocks carrying a #tag with their page, date (the page's daily date, or the day the page last changed) and task state. Optional date range and status filter.

limit.description: Most items to return. Default 50, at most 200.

name: tasks
description: Lists tasks (checkbox list items) with state, due date, completion date, tags, page title and key. state "open" means not done. due: "today" (due today), "overdue" (before today and open), "week" (today through 6 days ahead), or "range" with from and to. A task is due on the daily page it links to or sits on.

page.description: Page title, notebook-relative path such as "Projects/Plan.md", or "today" for today's daily page.

limit.description: Most items to return. Default 50, at most 200.

name: daily_pages
description: Returns the text of daily pages between two dates, oldest first, up to 60,000 characters in total.

name: mentions
description: Lists the pages that link to a page, newest daily page first, with how often each links it. Use it for "the last time we discussed X" or "the last occurrence of a meeting".

page.description: Page title, notebook-relative path such as "Projects/Plan.md", or "today" for today's daily page.

limit.description: Most items to return. Default 50, at most 200.

name: append_block
description: Adds Markdown as a new block at the end of a page, or of today's daily page. The change may wait for the writer's review; the result says whether it applied.

page.description: Page title, notebook-relative path such as "Projects/Plan.md", or "today" for today's daily page.

name: create_page
description: Creates a new page with a title and Markdown text.

name: replace_block
description: Replaces the text of one block, keeping its id and child blocks. Find it by id, or, for a block without one, by the key and page read_page listed. Pass the new text without the ^id marker. No id is added to a block found by key.

page.description: Page title, notebook-relative path such as "Projects/Plan.md", or "today" for today's daily page.

name: set_task_state
description: Changes a task's state. Pass the key from the tasks tool. Completing appends today's completion date.

name: capture_task
description: Adds one task to the Inbox page, or to today's daily page when the writer chose that in Settings, optionally linked to a project page.
